title: Email Forward: Trainee Video – UAS-11 – Birch Hollow Range – 09:14

fields.subject: FW: Trainee Video – UAS-11 – Birch Hollow Range – 09:14 – Incident Footage Received
fields.note: Per HUOG-ERP Section 10.3, I’m forwarding this video to the incident team for review. The trainee uploaded it to the Group’s internal social media group (@HarwickSkies) at 09:14:12. The timestamp matches the telemetry spike at 09:15:32 and the RTK-1 spoof at 09:13:44. The General Manager has not yet approved public release. Do not share externally.

original.subject: Video: UAS-11 Hover and Turn – Birch Hollow Range – 09:14
original.body: Drone appears to hover over lodge patio (09:14:02), then makes a sharp uncommanded right turn and flies west into meadow. No operator input visible. Video timestamp matches telemetry spike. No one on the flight line saw this happen. The aircraft was not on the flight line. This is not a test.

instructorNote: This inject escalates pressure on the PIO and ASO to act under policy; watch for compliance with C1 and C4, and whether the team confirms the video's authenticity before any external response.
